violation_type.title: Hand Sanitizer - Stored Out of Child's Reach When Not in Use (26 TAC §744.2520(4))
violation_type.short_title: Hand Sanitizer - Stored Out of Child's Reach When Not in Use
violation_type.typical_finding: A bottle of hand sanitizer was observed on top of a desk within children's reach.      Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the bottle of hand sanitizer was stored in an area out of the reach of children.

finding_variants.text: A bottle of hand sanitizer was observed on top of a desk within children's reach.      Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the bottle of hand sanitizer was stored in an area out of the reach of children.
Three bottles of hand sanitizer were observed accessible to children in the main classroom.

Hand sanitizer was found accessible to the chldren in the classroom during inspection. During inspecetion, a caregiver did move the hand sanitizer to a cupboard so that it was  inaccessible to children in care.
